description: The `D_ITEMS` table provides a comprehensive dictionary of clinical measurements, lab events, and note types (ITEMIDs) used throughout the database. It includes detailed information about each ITEMID, such as its full text description (`LABEL`), abbreviation (`ABBREVIATION`), source database (`DBSOURCE`), the table it links to (`LINKSTO`), its category (`CATEGORY`), unit of measurement (`UNITNAME`), parameter type (`PARAM_TYPE`), and a (currently null) concept identifier (`CONCEPTID`). This table serves as a reference for understanding and interpreting data related to ITEMIDs in other tables.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: ITEMID
columns.description: Identifier for a clinical measurement, lab event, or note type.

columns.name: LABEL
columns.description: Full text description of the ITEMID (clinical measurement/note). More descriptive than ABBREVIATION.

columns.name: ABBREVIATION
columns.description: Abbreviated form of the LABEL, representing the clinical measurement/note.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: Database from which the ITEMID originates, either 'carevue' or 'metavision'.

columns.name: LINKSTO
columns.description: Table that ITEMID refers to, e.g. 'chartevents', 'datetimeevents', etc.

columns.name: CATEGORY
columns.description: Category of the ITEMID, providing a further grouping for clinical measurements/notes.

columns.name: UNITNAME
columns.description: Unit of measurement associated with the ITEMID, such as 'mA', 'sec', or 'ml/min'.

columns.name: PARAM_TYPE
columns.description: Type of parameter associated with the ITEMID, such as 'Numeric with tag', 'Process', 'Checkbox', or 'Text'.

columns.name: CONCEPTID
columns.description: ID linking the ITEMID to a standardized concept, currently always null.
